item.title: Election Day Showdown, Lindsay Clancy Murder Hearing, Conservative Activist Attacked: AM Update 11/3 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Americans head to the polls on Election Day as Republicans fight to maintain control of Congress, with key Senate races in Texas, Michigan, Maine, and other battleground states determining the balance of power in Washington. A Massachusetts judge considers whether to dismiss the murder charges against Lindsay Clancy following a contentious hearing over the lone holdout juror in her first trial - The MK True Crime Show co-host Phil Holloway weighs in. Convicted murderer Christa Pike speaks publicly for the first time since surviving a botched execution in Tennessee, as a doctor reveals what went wrong during the lethal injection procedure. A University of Michigan student faces possible criminal charges after video captures her shoving conservative activist Lizzy Benichou to the ground and threatening to kill her during a confrontation on campus.
